name: The Stolen Journal
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard needs his stolen journal back. The Frostmane troll leader Grik'nir the Cold took it into the troll cave, and Grelin cannot finish his appraisal of the troll threat without his notes.

sections.title: A Scholar's Lost Notes
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard has watched the Frostmane trolls press into Coldridge Valley and recorded their habits and sudden aggression. In the unrest, an imposing troll stole his personal journal and fled into the depths of the trolls' den. The loss matters beyond sentiment: the notebook holds most of Grelin's reconnaissance. Until it is recovered from the cavern, his assessment of the threat remains unfinished.

sections.title: Confronting Grik'nir the Cold
sections.body: Grik'nir the Cold took Grelin's journal. The powerful Frostmane troll, marked with distinctive paint on his body and face, holds court in the heart of the valley's troll cave. Defeating Grik'nir breaks the cave trolls' immediate leadership and secures the journal. With it back, Grelin can finish his findings and judge the troll situation in Coldridge Valley manageable. He sends the completed report to his brother Senir.

faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold took Grelin Whitebeard's journal. The large Frostmane troll has strange markings on his skin and face, and lurks deep in the troll cave.

faq.q: Where can Grik'nir the Cold be found?
faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold is inside the troll cave in the southern reaches of Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Why is the journal important to Grelin?
aliases: why does grelin want his journal
faq.answer: Grelin's journal holds his notes and findings on troll activity in Coldridge Valley. He needs it back to complete a report for his brother Senir.

faq.q: What happens after you return the journal?
aliases: what is next after the stolen journal
faq.answer: After you recover the journal, Grelin finishes his report on the troll situation in Coldridge Valley and asks you to carry his findings to his brother Senir Whitebeard at Kharanos.

faq.q: Are the Frostmane trolls driven out of Coldridge Valley after this?
faq.answer: Grelin believes the troll situation in Coldridge Valley is under control after Grik'nir's defeat. The Frostmane remain a threat across Dun Morogh's broader mountain passes.
Senir Whitebeard is Grelin's brother, an Alliance scout stationed outside Coldridge Valley near Kharanos. He gathers intelligence on threats facing the kingdom.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you help protect young recruits taking their first steps beyond Anvilmar by breaking Frostmane leadership in Coldridge Valley.
As a gnome, you rely on the safety of Coldridge Valley's passes while gnomish refugees shelter in Anvilmar and regroup in dwarven territory.
As an Alliance member, you help keep Dun Morogh's starting valleys secure from disruption by suppressing the aggressive Frostmane tribe.
